# Jedi Mind Tricks

Jedi Mind Tricks is an act Dan Frank saw live 1 time between 2008, per the concert log he kept (preserved in the corpus). This page records those appearances and the details attached to each in the source.

## Notes per appearance

- **Nov 17, 2008** — Jedi Mind Tricks, The Social, Orlando, FL. Resolved. With Outerspace / Reef the Lost Cause.

**Corroborated from inside the room [2026-09-04].** The concert table's date
was established by routing checks. Two tweets that night establish it
independently, and they are the only record of what he made of it:

| Eastern time | Tweet |
|---|---|
| 2008-11-17, 21:19 | *"Jedi mind tricks"* |
| 2008-11-18, 01:50 | *"holy fuck, jedi mind tricks are so fucking scary."* |

The four-hour gap is the set. **"Scary" is the reaction and it is not a
complaint** — this is an Orlando audio student two months into Full Sail,
already deep in the emo and pop-punk circuit that fills the rest of autumn
2008 ([[wiki/self/twitter/2008]]), walking out of a Philadelphia
horrorcore show having enjoyed it. The taste is wider at twenty than the
concert table's overwhelmingly pop-punk 2008 rows suggest on their own.
